### Added

- (agent-platform) [Show no Harness turn limits](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3024) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The new agent wizard's runtime choice, its review step and the agent status card no longer show a Harness's budget and turn cap, which kagent 1.12.0 removed from the Harness. A session's cost still lists the cost the runtime reports.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Read the agents roster per namespace if forbidden](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3023) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For a person allowed to read kagent resources only in some namespaces, the Agents roster, a connector's Used by tab and a model's agents list the agents in those namespaces instead of saying they could not read the environment.
- (muster, ui-react) [Keep the MCP sign-in notice clear of the wizard footer](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3026) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The MCP sign-in notice in the bottom right sits above whatever is docked at the bottom of the page, so it no longer covers the new agent wizard's `Continue` and `Create` and takes their clicks.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.4.0...v3.5.0
